title: Repo hygiene: delete production debug scripts, uv.lock, dead deps and orphan test scripts
description:
Delete the August production-debugging scripts at the repo root (test-production-console-chat.sh, verify-console-chat-fix.sh, test_production_iam.py) and scripts/test-console-chat-production.sh; they hard-code AWS_PROFILE=Ryan, a production Lambda name and a DynamoDB table name. Delete uv.lock (last touched 2026-08-29, nothing references uv; poetry.lock is current). Remove dependencies with zero importers: ai, streamdown and @streamdown/* (4), katex from dependencies; d3, three, framer-motion from devDependencies (framer-motion duplicates motion). Delete components/ai-elements/message.tsx and conversation.tsx if nothing imports them after the removal. Delete the seven scripts/test-* files referenced by nothing (test-console-chat-production.{py,sh}, test-console-web-context.cjs, test-curation-client.ts, test-inbound-email-production.sh, test-publication-cyclotron-ui.ts, test-reference-source-preview.cjs). Extend .gitignore with .next-3001/, cdk.out/, infra/amplify-app-shell/node_modules/, infra/amplify-app-shell/cdk.out/, .pytest_cache/, .venv/, .ruff_cache/, .mypy_cache/, playwright-report/, test-results/. Delete CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.template.md if CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md is the live copy.

Done when: npm run typecheck and npm run build pass, and git status shows none of the listed files.

Source: full code review of develop @ e9b1923 on 2026-10-17 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). Branch from origin/develop, name the branch after this issue, open a PR into develop, and record branch, PR link and verification in a comment here before closing.
